svg.title: Draw it yourself: Week 31
svg.desc: A large empty framed panel with a dashed inner border and faint centre text reading your diagram here. The prompt asks the learner to draw their own yes-no question tree for five objects on a table, labelling every branch yes or no, marking the answers at the ends, and writing the number of questions on the longest path.
svg.text: Five things you can see from where you are sitting. One tree that tells them apart.
Label every branch yes or no. Ring the leaves. Write the depth in the corner.
